// Cuts every voxel of a selected colour, like the knives: it acts on the
// selection, so Rok starts it with one colour.
bool isSelected(float index) {
  for (int k = 0; k < i_num_color_sels; k++) {
    if (index == color_sel(float(k))) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
float map(vec3 v) {
  float index = voxel(v);
  return isSelected(index) ? 0.0 : index;
}
